chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 561: Li Huowang's Deadly Deal with the Imperial Preceptor
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang makes a desperate bargain with the Grand Liang Imperial Preceptor. A shocking truth about the Zuowandao is revealed. The hunt for Dice begins.
og_title: A Devil’s Bargain and the Unkillable Lie – Ch 561
og_description: The Imperial Preceptor steps in, forcing Li Huowang into a dangerous transaction. The shocking origin of the Zuowandao is finally revealed.
twitter_description: Li Huowang cuts a deal with the Imperial Preceptor to hunt Dice and learns a terrifying truth about the nature of lies in this world.

lore_anchors.definition: A ritual technique that uses water reflections to spy on a target and temporarily share their senses, allowing the user to pinpoint their location.
The personal weapon of the Grand Liang Imperial Preceptor, capable of flying and serving as a mount for sword flight.
In this novel's lore, the Zuowandao can never be truly destroyed because they are born from the very nature of lying itself. As long as a single lie exists in the world, a new Zuowandao can arise.
Ancient primordial beings who once farmed humans as livestock; the ancestors of humanity escaped their dominion by stealing the Mandate of Heaven.
A high-ranking member of the Zuowandao, currently disguised as a young eunuch within the Grand Liang Imperial Palace.
The Imperial Preceptor of Grand Liang, an immensely powerful and politically astute figure.
